_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: NEON SIGN
parts.hint: The bar's sign hides the relay: a green ring where the second O should be, with a black glass flame inside it that never lights. A stray cat sleeps on it where the neon is warm. Lit while every channel on the network answers

parts.label: STREET LAMP
parts.hint: Sodium light in the rain: it rains in Lowtown every day, and the neon never goes off

parts.label: STAIRWELL
parts.hint: The stairs down to the Low Note, a basement jazz bar under the overpass. Della Ash plays its piano and hears everything said in her bar

parts.label: OVERPASS
parts.hint: The elevated railway: trains run over the streets while hover-cabs weave between the towers

parts.label: PAVEMENT
parts.hint: Wet asphalt with the signs doubled in the puddles. In Lowtown, what you know is worth more than what you own

parts.label: FACADE
parts.hint: Brick and fire escapes over the bar: the city's mesh has been sold three times over, but nobody bothers to own the old bands
